title: 第5章 二级资格第6章 大摆宴席
content_zh:
田埂上，死寂无声。
所有人的目光都凝固了，视线在苏秦平静的脸、他那根还未完全放下的手指，以及地上那只死透了的黑背蝗之间来回移动。
风吹过，卷起一阵尘土，拂过众人僵硬的面庞。
那可是黑背蝗！
皮糙肉厚，寻常刀棍都难伤其分毫的害虫！
就这么……轻描淡写地，指了一下，就死了？
挡在最前面的李庚，后背的冷汗“唰”地一下就冒了出来。
他缓缓转过身，看着近在咫尺的苏秦，喉结上下滚动，却一个字也说不出来笑。
“秦……秦儿……”
苏海最先从震惊中挣脱出来。
他不是那些只知道埋头种地的乡民，他供儿子读道院，这些年耳濡目染，对修行的门道也懂一些。
他三步并作两步冲到苏秦面前，一把抓住儿子的手，上下翻看，仿佛想看穿他皮肉下的经脉。
“你的驱虫术……二级了？”
他的声音带着一丝难以置信的颤抖，每一个字都像是从牙缝里挤出来的。
一级法术，只能驱赶、骚扰。
唯有到了二级，法术才会发生质变，由“驱”转“杀”！
苏秦看着父亲布满血丝的双眼，感受着他手掌传来的灼热与力量，郑重地点了点头。
得到了肯定的答复，苏海的身子猛地一晃，眼眶瞬间就红了。
他松开儿子的手，转过身去，用力地揉了揉眼睛，似乎不想让旁人看到自己的失态。
二级！

竟然是二级了！
旁人不懂，他却清楚得很！
青云府道院，从一级院升二级院，最重要的一个考核标准，便是至少掌握一门二级法术！
在此之前，苏秦的前途在他看来，不过是镜中花，水中月。
他砸锅卖铁地供养，嘴上说着让儿子争气，心里却只是抱着一丝渺茫的希望，求一个祖坟冒青烟的奇迹。
可现在，这奇迹真真切切地摆在了眼前！
那扇通往上层世界、通往官身的大门，不再是虚无缥缈的幻想，而是一条看得见、摸得着的康庄大道！
巨大的狂喜过后，更深的担忧涌了上来。
苏海猛地回过身，脸上的激动瞬间被严肃取代。
“快回去！”
他压低声音，语气却比之前更加不容置疑
“二级法术耗费的元气，不是你现在能轻易承担的！
content_en:
On the field ridge, there was deathly silence.
Everyone's eyes froze, moving back and forth between Su Qin's calm face, his finger that hadn't been completely put down, and the dead black-backed locust on the ground.
The wind blew, picking up a cloud of dust and brushing against everyone's stiff faces.
That's a black-backed locust!
It is a pest with rough skin and thick flesh that cannot be harmed even by ordinary knives and sticks!
Just like that... he pointed it lightly and died?
Li Geng, who was standing in the front, suddenly broke out in cold sweat on his back.
He slowly turned around and looked at Su Qin who was very close at hand. His Adam's apple rolled up and down, but he couldn't say a word to smile.
"Qin...Qin'er..."
Su Hai was the first to break free from the shock.
He is not one of those villagers who just immerses himself in farming. He has provided for his son to study in a Taoist academy. Over the years, he has been exposed to it and knows a little about the ways of spiritual practice.
He rushed to Su Qin in three steps at a time, grabbed his son's hand, and looked up and down, as if he wanted to see through the meridians under his skin.
"Is your insect repellent...level two?"
His voice was trembling with disbelief, and every word seemed to be squeezed out from between his teeth.
Level 1 spells can only drive away and harass.
Only when it reaches the second level will the spell undergo a qualitative change, from "driving" to "killing"!
Su Qin looked at his father's bloodshot eyes, felt the heat and power from his palm, and nodded solemnly.
After receiving an affirmative answer, Su Hai's body swayed suddenly, and his eyes instantly turned red.
He let go of his son's hand, turned around, and rubbed his eyes vigorously, as if he didn't want others to see his gaffe.
Level 2!
It’s actually Level 2!
Others don’t understand, but he knows it very well!
For Qingyun Mansion Taoist Academy, the most important assessment criterion for advancing from the first-level academy to the second-level academy is to master at least one second-level spell!
Before that, Su Qin's future, in his opinion, was just a flower in the mirror and a moon in the water.
He smashed pots and sold iron fields to support him, saying that he wanted his son to succeed, but in his heart he only held a faint hope, praying for a miracle of smoke rising from his ancestral graves.
But now, this miracle is really before our eyes!
The door leading to the upper world and to the official body is no longer a vague fantasy, but a broad road that can be seen and touched!
After the great ecstasy, deeper worries emerged.
Su Hai turned around suddenly, and the excitement on his face was instantly replaced by seriousness.
"Go back quickly!"
He lowered his voice, but his tone was even more unquestionable than before.
"The vitality consumed by the second-level spell is not something you can easily bear now!
